scope_assumption: Review the supplied recommendations and deliver a candidate P0 plan; this packet introduces no new experiment or policy.
question: Can a pre-action assessment of a biological transfer premise identify a qualified observation that improves the final functional decision?

current_feasibility.functional_decision_diagnosis: Existing exposed data can support bounded retrospective analysis; a distinct follow-up hypothesis or evidence channel is required before another study.

required_qualification: One declared endpoint and terminal action menu; efficacy, selectivity, RNA and engagement kept distinct
Compound/cell identity, dose, duration, platform and source snapshot
Acquisition and terminal measurement unit linkage, independent-culture and crossed-repeat provenance when required by the claim
A lawful observation with source-supported distinguishable observable consequences; bounded unknown alternative remains allowed
All outcome-derived fitting statistics isolated; pre-action recruitment and trigger
Frozen final choices before terminal scoring, explicit missingness and failed-purchase handling
Useful margin, sample-size rationale, resource cap and cost conversion justified before a new evaluation

headroom_references.exact_terminal_oracle: Retrospective realized regret on a complete fixed outcome menu; not purchasable information or cause truth
headroom_references.full_menu_frozen_updater: A model-specific diagnostic, often over budget; not an upper bound over methods
headroom_references.legal_paid_action: Budget-feasible realized utility increment for a frozen action and update policy
headroom_references.missing_terminal_values: No exact full-library oracle without additional justified assumptions; never replace selected identities using hidden availability

phases.purpose: Qualify one genuinely distinguishable evidence channel or crossed repeat design
phases.candidate_source_check: Official PRISM replicate treatment/pool metadata, exposure protocol and culture provenance; alternative small paired source if these cannot qualify the claim

phases.purpose: Separate baseline decision error from useful lawful evidence on development data
Minimal functional diagnostic after data and hypothesis qualification
Agent attribution only after a meaningful legal choice and evidence value exist
Independent confirmation and optional two-core factorial attribution

bounded_case_outcomes.NON_IDENTIFIABLE: No separating action in the registered menu under the stated assumptions; not a universal biological impossibility theorem
bounded_case_outcomes.MODEL_MISMATCH: Observed evidence inconsistent with registered predictive support; not identification of its cause
bounded_case_outcomes.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Evidence or qualification inadequate for the proposed inference
bounded_case_outcomes.NOT_EVALUABLE: The required endpoint or measurement correspondence is absent

continue_rule: Progress only after the particular claim, lawful evidence and terminal scoring are qualified, and a new frozen diagnostic supports useful decision gain. Do not infer benefit from MSE, ranking change, graph presence or persuasive explanation.
